title: Fruitbridge TierTag
description: A mod that simply adds the visibility of fruitbridging tiers ingame.
body:
# This mod adds _tiers_ from the **fruitbridging discord** into the game!

**NOTE**: the tiers are hardcoded into the jar for now, so your username needs to be tested in the fruitbridging discord, and then there will be an update, containing your tier. meaning, your username will be in the code of the mod, acessible to be seen by anyone

join the fruitbridging community: [here!](https://discord.gg/2snjK2K8)

Here is an example of how the tier looks ingame!
![LT1 example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4d10c06461d8ba1335cc274d2c8188b9a23748b2.png)

the tiers range from HT1 down to LT5, with diffrent colors for each tier.
